import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import json
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from scipy.sparse import hstack, csr_matrix
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Define file paths
train_path = "./input/train/train.json"
test_path = "./input/test/test.json"
sample_submission_path = "./input/sampleSubmission.csv"
submission_dir = "./submission"
submission_path = os.path.join(submission_dir, "submission.csv")

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs(submission_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Load Data
with open(train_path, "r") as f:
    train_data = json.load(f)
with open(test_path, "r") as f:
    test_data = json.load(f)

# Convert to DataFrame
df_train = pd.DataFrame(train_data)
df_test = pd.DataFrame(test_data)


# Feature Engineering Function
def preprocess(df):
    # Numerical features base
    num_cols = [
        "requester_account_age_in_days_at_request",
        "requester_days_since_first_post_on_raop_at_request",
        "requester_number_of_comments_at_request",
        "requester_number_of_comments_in_raop_at_request",
        "requester_number_of_posts_at_request",
        "requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request",
        "requester_number_of_subreddits_at_request",
        "requester_upvotes_minus_downvotes_at_request",
        "requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request",
        "unix_timestamp_of_request",
        "unix_timestamp_of_request_utc",
    ]

    # Handle missing values for numerical columns
    for col in num_cols:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = df[col].fillna(0)
        else:
            df[col] = 0

    # Boolean/Categorical features
    # post_was_edited
    if "post_was_edited" in df.columns:
        df["post_was_edited"] = df["post_was_edited"].astype(int)
    else:
        df["post_was_edited"] = 0

    # REMOVED: has_giver feature due to target leakage

    # Text features
    # Combine title and text (using edit_aware for consistency with test set)
    df["text_combined"] = (
        df["request_title"].fillna("") + " " + df["request_text_edit_aware"].fillna("")
    )

    # Text statistics
    df["text_length"] = df["text_combined"].str.len()
    df["word_count"] = df["text_combined"].str.split().str.len().fillna(0)

    # Subreddit list length
    df["subreddit_count"] = df["requester_subreddits_at_request"].apply(
        lambda x: len(x) if isinstance(x, list) else 0
    )

    # User engagement ratio features
    # Karma ratio
    df["karma_ratio"] = np.where(
        df["requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request"] > 0,
        df["requester_upvotes_minus_downvotes_at_request"]
        / df["requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request"],
        0,
    )

    # Comment to post ratio
    df["comment_post_ratio"] = np.where(
        df["requester_number_of_posts_at_request"] > 0,
        df["requester_number_of_comments_at_request"]
        / df["requester_number_of_posts_at_request"],
        0,
    )

    # RAOP activity ratio
    df["raop_comment_ratio"] = np.where(
        df["requester_number_of_comments_at_request"] > 0,
        df["requester_number_of_comments_in_raop_at_request"]
        / df["requester_number_of_comments_at_request"],
        0,
    )

    # RAOP post ratio
    df["raop_post_ratio"] = np.where(
        df["requester_number_of_posts_at_request"] > 0,
        df["requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request"]
        / df["requester_number_of_posts_at_request"],
        0,
    )

    # NEW: Time-based features from unix_timestamp_of_request
    # Convert to datetime
    df["request_time"] = pd.to_datetime(
        df["unix_timestamp_of_request"], unit="s", errors="coerce"
    )
    # Fill NaT with a default date (e.g., 1970-01-01) to avoid errors
    df["request_time"] = df["request_time"].fillna(pd.Timestamp("1970-01-01"))

    df["request_hour"] = df["request_time"].dt.hour
    df["request_day_of_week"] = df["request_time"].dt.dayofweek
    df["request_month"] = df["request_time"].dt.month
    df["is_weekend"] = (df["request_time"].dt.dayofweek >= 5).astype(int)
    df["is_night"] = (
        (df["request_time"].dt.hour >= 22) | (df["request_time"].dt.hour <= 5)
    ).astype(int)

    return df


df_train = preprocess(df_train)
df_test = preprocess(df_test)

# Define Feature Columns (Removed has_giver, Added time features)
num_features = [
    "requester_account_age_in_days_at_request",
    "requester_days_since_first_post_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_in_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_subreddits_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_minus_downvotes_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request",
    "unix_timestamp_of_request",
    "unix_timestamp_of_request_utc",
    "post_was_edited",
    "text_length",
    "word_count",
    "subreddit_count",
    "karma_ratio",
    "comment_post_ratio",
    "raop_comment_ratio",
    "raop_post_ratio",
    "request_hour",
    "request_day_of_week",
    "request_month",
    "is_weekend",
    "is_night",
]

# Prepare Text Vectorizer
tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=5000, stop_words="english", ngram_range=(1, 2))
text_features_train = tfidf.fit_transform(df_train["text_combined"])
text_features_test = tfidf.transform(df_test["text_combined"])

# Prepare Tabular Features
X_train_num = df_train[num_features].values
X_test_num = df_test[num_features].values

# Combine Features (Sparse Matrix)
X_train = hstack([csr_matrix(X_train_num), text_features_train])
X_test = hstack([csr_matrix(X_test_num), text_features_test])

y_train = df_train["requester_received_pizza"].astype(int)

# Split for Validation (80/20)
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42
)

# Train Model (RandomForest - same hyperparameters as previous solution)
model = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=200, max_depth=10, random_state=42, n_jobs=-1
)
model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

# Validate
val_preds = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_preds)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.4f}")

# Retrain on Full Training Data for Submission
model_full = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=200, max_depth=10, random_state=42, n_jobs=-1
)
model_full.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Predict on Test
test_preds = model_full.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Load Sample Submission to get IDs
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(sample_submission_path)

# Create Submission
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {"request_id": sample_sub["request_id"], "requester_received_pizza": test_preds}
)

# Save
submission.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {submission_path}")
